summary: The implementation delivers a fully functional brick breaker game with interactive gameplay, smooth animations, and a vibrant visual theme. However, backend persistence for game scores (REQ-3) is completely missing—the backend file is empty and scores are only stored in local component state. The frontend image requirement for a game controller icon is also not addressed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Store and retrieve game scores or progress in the backend
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo file contains only an empty actor with no methods for storing or retrieving game data. Scores are managed entirely in frontend component state (GamePage.tsx) with no backend persistence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Game controller icon in a modern flat style (controller-icon.dim_128x128.png)
missing_requirements.reason: The required controller-icon image is not present in the diff. The header uses a lucide-react Gamepad2 icon instead of the specified static image asset.
